title: In CapCut, access Seedance 2.0 by going to AI tools (Expand or AI Creator Hub)…
content:
In CapCut, access Seedance 2.0 by going to AI tools (Expand or AI Creator Hub) and selecting Text to Video instead of starting a normal project  
Start Seedance prompts with Create a video of… to ensure it generates video (not an image)  
Use detailed prompts with subject + environment + time + lighting + camera framing (e.g., rainy neon city at night, cinematic lighting, close-up shot) instead of short prompts like A man walking  
After generating, set output quality to 1080p for higher-quality results  
Choose aspect ratio based on platform (use 9:16 for TikTok)  
Adjust the motion setting to increase realism  
Keep characters consistent by repeating the exact same character description in every prompt  
Iterate quickly by testing multiple prompt variations and keeping the best-performing one  
Save prompts that work and reuse them to scale faster  
To get free Seedance 2.0 generations, use a VPN set to China, then open the provided link and use the Image Generator (it auto-switches to Seedance 2.0 when you enter a video prompt)  
If the tool returns images, add the Create a video of… format to force video output  
Get 5 free videos without login, then change your VPN IP and refresh to get 5 more
